ctx.privacy.attachments: When it reads an attachment for you, it sends the attachment's text.
ctx.privacy.images: Pictures it looks at go along as images. The date and place a photo was taken go only when you ask for them.
ctx.privacy.thread: When it reads the whole conversation, it sends every message in it.
ctx.privacy.selection: When you ask about the messages you selected in the list, it sends them.
ctx.privacy.mentions: Messages and contacts you mention with @ go along too.
ctx.settings.title: More context
ctx.settings.hint: What the assistant may read besides the open message, when your question needs it.
ctx.settings.attachments_hint: It reads the text of a message's attachments: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, text and calendar files.
ctx.settings.images_hint: It looks at attached pictures and pictures in the message. Off: it only gets their file names.
ctx.settings.no_images: This model can't see images. The assistant only gets the file name.
ctx.settings.own_images_hint: Turn this on only if the model you connected takes pictures. Otherwise requests with pictures fail.
ctx.settings.thread_hint: It reads every message of the open conversation when the question needs it.
